overview: Studying Public Health (MBBS Abroad) in Finland offers Indian students access to world-renowned Nordic education, innovative practical research, English-taught programmes, and excellent European career pathways.

faq.question: Can Indian students study Public Health in Finland?
faq.answer: Yes, **Indian students can apply** for English-taught Public Health Master

faq.question: Is Public Health taught in English in Finland?
What is the tuition fee for Public Health in Finland?
faq.answer: At the University of Eastern Finland, the annual tuition fee for non-EU/EEA students is **€10,000 per year**. UEF offers generous **early bird discounts (up to 30%)** and academic progress waivers for second-year studies.
